The study's abstract describes a review article that summarizes the strengths and limitations of conventional and novel (microfluidic) extracellular vesicle (EV) isolation strategies, surveys commercially available exosome isolation techniques and kits, and assesses the global market demand for exosome assays.

In contrast, the candidate hypothesis proposes a specific integrated system combining a real-time convolutional neural network (CNN) machine learning framework, size-exclusion chromatography (SEC), and label-free surface plasmon resonance imaging (SPRi) with an antibody microarray, validated via simulation models and existing datasets for cancer, neurodegenerative, and cardiovascular disease applications. None of these technologies, methods, or disease-specific validations are mentioned or supported by the provided abstract.

VERDICT: REJECT
